title: Form 1040
about: Form 1040 and Schedule 1: the lines a business ledger feeds - Schedule 1 line 3 (Schedule C) and line 5 (Schedule E) - and every other line named as not from the books. Line numbers of the 2025 forms.

reports.label: Form 1040 (Draft)

rows.label: Taxable refunds, credits, or offsets of state and local income taxes
Business income or (loss) - Schedule C, line 31
Rental real estate, royalties, partnerships, S corporations, trusts - Schedule E, line 41
Lines 3 and 5 - the part of line 10 the books give
Additional income from Schedule 1, line 10 - the books' part

notes: Pick the entities that file on this person's return. Each entity counts on Schedule C or Schedule E as set in Line Mapping (one row per entity) - an entity whose revenue is mostly rent is suggested as Schedule E. Its Schedule C line 31 or Schedule E line 41 comes from that form's own mapping for the entity - open Schedule C (Draft) or Schedule E (Draft) to see the lines.
Everything else on the return - wages, interest, dividends, deductions, credits and tax - is the preparer's, from the person's own records.
